value.definition: when a five-hour allowance comes back, a spent seven-day window holding it back

invariants.statement: An account that has spent its seven-day window has no five-hour reset.
An account that has spent its five-hour window has that window's own reset.
An account stating no five-hour reset has no five-hour reset.
A seven-day window nothing has been read of holds no reset back.

value.definition: what an hour of a stretch costs, read off safety against difficulty

invariants.statement: The gap a cost is read from is the safety level less the difficulty level.
A stretch a full level inside the safety level costs nothing.
A stretch at the safety level costs one hour for each hour that stretch ran.
Each level the gap falls beneath the match roughly doubles the cost.
A gap is read at the nearest half step.
A half step is the finest step a level moves in.
A stretch stating no safety level or no difficulty level costs nothing.

value.definition: the hours from one instant to another

invariants.statement: The hours are the same whichever instant is handed in first.
An end that is no readable instant is no reading rather than zero.
